proposals.evidence: DEDR3582 gives Tamil naṭa, Malayalam naṭakka, Kannada naḍe/naḍi, Kodagu naḍa- and Tulu naḍapuni to walk. These complete southern survey naḍa/naḍi/naḍakk-/naḍap- forms preserve the stem and source inflection; the Kudiya naḍapu comparison follows intransitive Tulu naḍapuni, not Kannada causative naḍapu. Longer or opaque responses are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR601 gives Tamil uṇaṅku, Malayalam uṇaṅṅuka, Kannada oṇagu, Tulu oṇuṅgelu/uṇuṅgu/nuṅgu dry and dry up. These unag-/oṇag-/voṇag-/nuṅg- survey responses preserve that drying stem, ordinary adjectival endings and initial glide; potentially competing nānt-/nan- readings are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
